description: Shared type definitions for Open Gaming achievements and leaderboards.

inlineSignature.description: An inline CID-first cryptographic attestation (compatible with the badge.blue / atproto-attestation specification). Computed over the DAG-CBOR CIDv1 of the parent record with `signatures` stripped and `$sig` injected containing `repository: <playerDid>`.

key.description: Verification method URI or DID key used to sign the attestation CID (e.g. `did:plc:gamepublisher#attestations` or `did:key:z...`).

signature.description: Normalized low-S ECDSA signature bytes over the repository-bound attestation CIDv1 bytes.

issuer.description: Optional DID of the game publisher or authority issuing the attestation.

issuedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the signature was generated.

cid.description: Optional explicit copy of the computed attestation CIDv1 (`bafy...`) that was signed.

scoreFormat.description: Formatting rules for integer leaderboard scores (modeled on Google Play Games Services score formatting, compatible with ATProto's integer-only data model).

kind.description: How raw integer scores should be interpreted for display.

decimalPlaces.description: Fixed decimal point offset for `numeric` or `currency` scores. For example, raw integer `314159` with `decimalPlaces: 2` displays as `3,141.59`.

timeUnit.description: Base integer unit for `time` leaderboards. For example, `66032` with `milliseconds` displays as `1:06.03`.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. `USD`) when `kind` is `currency`. Following Play Games Services, micro-units (`decimalPlaces: 6`) or cents (`decimalPlaces: 2`) may be used.

unitSingular.description: Optional custom singular unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meter`, `pipe`, `like`, `pt`).

unitPlural.description: Optional custom plural unit label for `numeric` scores (e.g. `meters`, `pipes`, `likes`, `pts`).
